item.title: Show HN：CtrlTool – 132 个用于开发人员和日常任务的免费在线工具
item.description: 嘿 HN，我构建 CtrlTool 是因为我一直需要一些小工具来处理随机的事情，并且不想安装某些东西或注册另一个网站。它目前有 132 个工具，用于 JSON、JWT、Base64、URL、文本、散列、PDF、SEO、转换器、生成器和其他日常用品。我试图关注的主要事情是使工具快速而简单。 For tools where it makes sense, everything runs locally in the browser so the data doesn't need to be uploaded to a server.It's still very new, so I'm mostly looking for feedback on the UX, which tools are actually useful, and what you think is missing.https://ctrltool.wtfWould appreciate any feedback. <小时/> 评论网址：https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49365318 积分：1 # 条评论：0
